watchlist.page.title.description: Title of the Watchlist page, the destination of the bookmark tab in the tab strip.

watchlist.page.sort_filter.description: The name of the Watchlist header's sort control (the one that opens the sort and filter popover). Never drawn: the control shows the chosen sort next to the sort icon, so this string has no width limit to fit; it is the control's identity in the row.

watchlist.filter.type_all.description: Type filter choice: both movies and TV shows in the Watchlist.

watchlist.filter.type_movies.description: Type filter choice: movies only in the Watchlist.

watchlist.filter.type_shows.description: Type filter choice: TV shows only in the Watchlist.

watchlist.filter.show_all.description: Availability filter choice: every title on the Watchlist.

watchlist.filter.show_released.description: Availability filter choice: only titles that have been released.

watchlist.filter.show_on_servers.description: Availability filter choice: only titles found on one of the account's reachable servers.

watchlist.action.add.description: Button and menu row that adds a movie or a catalogue title to the Watchlist. Also the outline face of the catalogue page's Watchlist pill.

watchlist.action.add_show.description: Episode hold-menu row that adds the whole show to the Watchlist.

watchlist.action.on_list.description: Filled face of the catalogue page's Watchlist pill when the title is already on the Watchlist. Shows state, not an action.

watchlist.action.remove.description: Menu row that removes a movie or catalogue title from the Watchlist. Destructive styling.

watchlist.action.remove_show.description: Episode hold-menu row that removes the show from the Watchlist. The ellipsis is part of the label.

watchlist.state.coming_on.description: The one release-date phrase of an unreleased title: the Watchlist's focus caption and the catalogue page's line. The date is a short month-and-day phrase such as 12 Mar (caption) or 12 March (page).

watchlist.state.coming_soon.description: Status line on a catalogue title that has no release date on a server yet and is not on any server.

watchlist.state.on_no_server.description: Status line on a released Watchlist title that none of the account's servers has.

watchlist.state.server_offline.description: Status line on a Watchlist title whose only matching servers are currently unreachable.

watchlist.empty.list.description: Full-screen verdict on the Watchlist page when the account has no titles on it.

watchlist.empty.filtered.description: Full-screen verdict on the Watchlist page when the sort and filter choices leave no title.

watchlist.empty.no_token.value: Watchlist isn’t available for this profile
watchlist.empty.no_token.description: Full-screen verdict on the Watchlist page for a managed profile that has no plex.tv sign-in to read a list with.

watchlist.empty.list_body.value: Titles you add to your Watchlist on any device show up here.

watchlist.empty.filtered_body.value: Change Sort & Filter to see the rest of your Watchlist.
watchlist.empty.filtered_body.description: Line under the verdict shown when the Watchlist's sort and filter choices leave no title.

watchlist.empty.unreachable.description: Full-screen verdict on the Watchlist page when plex.tv could not be read and no list had loaded yet; it carries a Try again button.

watchlist.detail.trailer.description: Button on a catalogue title's page that plays its trailer. Shown only where a trailer exists.

watchlist.page.debug_write_blocked.description: Developer builds only, never shown to users: a line under the Watchlist title saying the last add or remove was not sent, because a test build does not write to the real account.
